outcome: When a creature with renown deals combat damage to a player and is not renowned, it gets N +1/+1 counters and becomes renowned; if already renowned, the trigger does not fire.
Renowned stays on a permanent until it leaves the battlefield and is not copied, so a blinked creature is no longer renowned.
note: Designation is not captured in any field.

outcome: With multiple instances of renown each triggers, but only the first to resolve adds counters and the rest do nothing due to the intervening if.
